Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF21970–21970; the source closing at LF22177–22178 reads: Dato dalle stanze del Vaticano li 22 no- vembre 1836. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
